rawText: EL ENEMIGO CABERNET FRANC 2019 Mendoza · Argentina
description: El Enemigo is a project of Alejandro Vigil and Adrianna Catena, based in Mendoza, Argentina. This Cabernet Franc is sourced from high-altitude vineyards in the Uco Valley, a sub-region known for its stony, alluvial soils and significant diurnal temperature variation, which favor aromatic freshness and structure in the variety.
